messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 — hosted runtime kvcache OOM spike detected in prod-east-1. kvcache_mem_pct > 98%, evictions spiking, a handful of OOM container restarts seen across hosted-runtime pool. auto-alert triggered at 2026-03-15T04:12Z

sofia (oncall): on it. collecting logs + assigning. tagging @jia and @mike. do we have affected tenants list?

jia (eng-sre): seeing large prefix amplification. continuous-batching queue depth jumped ~8x starting 04:08Z. some sessions show extremely long prompts, kvcache entries ballooned.

mike (eng-runtime): logs show repeated client behavior sending giant context windows (200k+ tokens) repeatedly for the same session ids — looks like a runaway append loop on client side. also saw a change in batching heuristic in last deploy.

dave (support): customers reporting 500s and increased latency. confirmed payments-app-prod and transcripts-pro are reporting errors. severity flags on both.

sofia (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) throttle/disable kvcache prefetch on hosted runtime immediately 2) reduce continuous-batching window config 3) route heavy tenants to fallback smaller model while we stabilize. executing now.

sofia (oncall): applying feature-flag patch to throttle prefetch 
```
curl -X POST https://admin.internal.redwood/v1/feature-flags \
  -H "Authorization: Token $ADMIN" \
  -d '{"prefetch_kv_enabled":false,"prefetch_cap":512}'
```

deploy-bot: Hotfix canary deployed to hosted-runtime/canary-3 by sofia — build 2026.03.15-hotfix-001 :white_check_mark:

mike (eng-runtime): also bumping continuous-batching.max_window down to 8 from 64 to cut batch expansion:
```
kubectl -n runtime set env deploy/hosted-runtime CONT_BATCH_MAX_WINDOW=8
```

jia (eng-sre): metrics update: kvcache_mem_pct dropped from 99.1% -> 62% within 6 minutes after canary. eviction rate back to baseline. no further OOMs observed post-change.

sofia (oncall): routing note: shifted payments-app-prod + transcripts-pro to fallback model redwood-mini-v2 for 15m to reduce per-request KV footprint.

dave (support): drafted customer message. sending after your ack: "We observed transient OOMs on the hosted runtime caused by runaway context windows and prefix amplification. We've throttled prefetch and applied a hotfix; service is stable. We'll follow up with a detailed RCA and mitigation timeline."

sofia (oncall): send now. also add an ops note to billing impact tracker.

mike (eng-runtime): follow-ups (action items): - postmortem owner: @mike (RCA due EOD) - implement prefetch circuit-breaker for excessive session growth - per-session token caps + guardrails - add automated alert when kvcache growth rate > 50%/min

jia (eng-sre): quick diagnostic dump:
```
# top keys by size
session:abcd1234 1113MB
session:efgh5678 980MB
session:qwer9999 640MB
```

sofia (oncall): handoff to @mike in 30m — current state: hotfix live on canary then rolled to majority of hosted pool, prefetch disabled, batch window reduced, affected tenants routed to smaller model. monitoring for regressions. I'll be offline after handoff.

mike (eng-runtime): ack. will watch dashboards and alerts. if memory pressure returns, plan is to re-enable prefetch with conservative cap and increase eviction aggressiveness, or divert traffic to Dedicated pools.

deploy-bot: Incident update posted to status page by sofia — short customer notification live.

incident-bot: Incident status update: status=mitigated; severity=P2; SLA impact window 04:11Z-04:20Z; customers impacted: payments-app-prod, transcripts-pro. incident id=4719987654 :white_check_mark:

sofia (oncall): next steps: schedule post-incident review with runtime + client-eng within 24h; add regression tests around batching heuristics and KV prefetch; add a canary limit to prevent global rollout of prefetch changes without traffic shaping.

dave (support): creating support tickets and linking to incident id 4719987654. will attach customer logs.

mike (eng-runtime): adding a temporary ergodic monitor to detect prefix amplification patterns; will propose longer term fixes in RCA.

sofia (oncall): closing live paging. handoff complete. :white_check_mark:
